ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isnt a perk. Its the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?

Heres a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:At ING, were building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agreeThe MissionWe are a Business Intelligence squad responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data-driven solutions across the Payments domain. Our solutions provide business stakeholders with trusted insights through ETL processes, data models, and Power BI dashboards that support operational, tactical, and strategic decision-making. As a Senior IT Business Analyst, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and the engineering team, translating business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications that drive the development of data pipelines, semantic models, and reporting solutions. Your day to day Business & Requirements Analysis Gather, challenge, and document business requirements from stakeholders across the Payments domain. Translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Analyze impacts, dependencies, data flows, and cross-system interactions. Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and aligned with business objectives and data governance standards. Support backlog management and prioritization together with the Product Owner. Maintain functional and technical documentation throughout the solution lifecycle. Data Analysis & Solution Design Analyze source systems, data structures, and business processes to understand data requirements. Perform data analysis and data profiling to assess data quality, completeness, and consistency. Define business rules, KPIs, measures, dimensions, and reporting requirements. Create functional specifications and technical documentation for data engineering and BI development teams. Collaborate with engineers on the design of ETL processes, data transformations, and data models. Support onboarding of new data sources and integration of payments-related datasets. Power BI & Reporting Create dashboards and reporting solutions. Validate report calculations, measures, and business logic. Contribute to dashboard design discussions, ensuring reporting solutions meet business needs. Support report testing, user acceptance testing, and rollout activities. Drive continuous improvements in reporting usability and data visualization. What youll bring to the team Experience: 8+ years Strong Business Analysis skills, including requirements gathering, process analysis, and backlog refinement. Experience translating business requirements into functional and technical specifications. Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to bridge business and IT teams. Practical experience working Agile in cross-functional teams. Experience working with BI, Analytics, Data Warehouse, and Reporting solutions. Strong Data Analysis skills, including data quality analysis, KPI definition, and business data validation. Advanced SQL knowledge and experience analyzing large datasets. Hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and dashboard development. Good understanding of ETL processes, data models, and reporting solutions. Knowledge of Payments domain, including payment flows, reconciliation, settlement, and reporting processes. Familiar with Release Management concepts (minor, major, release notes etc.). Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Accurately defines the key elements of complex, ambiguous situations. Experience with the testing process - good understanding of the different types of testing (progression, non-regression, INT, UAT), can elaborate test scenarios in support of INT/UAT and can perform testing if necessaryTech stack/ knowledge: Mandatory: affinity for TECH/IT, Microsoft stack (SSAS, SSIS, SQL, PBI) Foreign languages: English (advanced) -Mandatory Education: Bachelors Degree (or higher) in an Economic or IT related field If you want to deep dive into the processing of personal data conducted by ING Hubs Romania during the recruitment process and your rights related to it, read the privacy notices on our website (make sure to scroll until you reach the Data Protection section/ Candidates tab).
